connector.name: FRED (economic data)
connector.registryDescription: FRED economic time series + ALFRED vintages: data as originally published, before revisions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcpwright-fred. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mcpwright account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FRED_API_KEY
env.description: Your own free FRED API key (get one at fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key_request.html). Keys are personal under the FRED API Terms of Use.

env.name: FRED_MCP_USER_AGENT
env.description: Descriptive User-Agent identifying your deployment. Optional.
